# Cornelia Bryant

[Conservative](../codex/factions.md#conservative)

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P0](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0000)</sub>
- **Family:** [Marshall](../character/marshall.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Cornelia Bryant features a fresh, round, pink-and-white face complemented by jolly brown eyes. Her fair hair is styled into a hard little knob, which is held securely in place by a tight elastic band.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019)_

## Personality

Cornelia Bryant is a woman known for pairing a bitter, outspoken tongue with a remarkably kind heart. She harbors a distinct disdain for men, making it a point of principle to snub any high-sounding language from them and remaining perpetually vigilant where they are concerned. For recreation, she enjoys reading obituary notices, though behind her sharp exterior she considers herself a lonely soul who avoids useless arguments once something is inevitable. Additionally, she is an exceptionally talented cook, famous for her prize-winning lemon pies and skilled at sewing and hand embroidery.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P27](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P76](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0076), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P35](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P41](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0041), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), +5 more_

## History

Miss Cornelia Bryant, a candid local resident with strong opinions on men, ministers, and neighbors, introduced herself to [Anne](../character/anne.md) [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) by calling at her home shortly after [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) settled in [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor). She frequented the house to share local news, including the tragic history of their neighbor [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), whom she encouraged [Anne](../character/anne.md) to befriend. Cornelia frequently joined the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) and Captain Jim for gatherings, engaging in spirited debates over holiday dinners and casual visits. Though she often expressed fierce opinions, such as her strong disapproval when [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposed a medical operation to cure [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md), she maintained close ties with the household. After the operation ultimately revealed that the man was not [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md), Cornelia arrived at Anne's in total shock to discuss Leslie's sudden freedom. She remained a fixture in the community through seasonal celebrations, political discussions, and personal milestones, including the birth of Anne's son. Cornelia eventually surprised her friends by announcing her intention to marry [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md), putting aside her long-held, sharp criticisms of men.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P0](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P1](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P2](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P3](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P8](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0008), +713 more_

## Quotes

> "I have the Methodist minister’s word for it—if you call THAT proof. Robert Baxter told me the same thing too, but I admit THAT isn’t evidence. Robert Baxter isn’t often known to tell the truth."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P16](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0016)

> "You always look as cool as a cucumber, Anne, dearie. Do I smell cherry pie? If I do, ask me to stay to tea. Haven’t tasted a cherry pie this summer. My cherries have all been stolen by those scamps of Gilman boys from the Glen."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P12](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0012)

> "There’s a great change come over her lately. She laughs and jokes like a girl, and from her talk I gather she’s here real often."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P25](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0025)

> "Now, you needn’t Miss Cornelia me, Anne, dearie. ANYBODY would have thought the same. If the Montreal doctors can make a rational creature out of Dick Moore they’re wonders."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P4](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0004)

> "Anne, dearie, I’d a letter from Owen Ford yesterday. He’s in Vancouver just now, but he wants to know if I can board him for a month later on. YOU know what that means. Well, I hope we’re doing right."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P30](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0030)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--cornelia-bryant.md)

Cornelia first called on [Anne](../character/anne.md) during Anne's honeymoon month at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), bringing her sewing and offering her frank, sharp opinions on local neighbors and men. Over their frequent visits, the two developed a close bond as kindred spirits and friends. Cornelia often shares local news and deep backstory with [Anne](../character/anne.md), such as the tragic history of [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), and frequently stays to enjoy tea with her.

- Friend of — kindred spirits and friends  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P75](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0075), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P76](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0076), +4 more</sub>

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--leslie-moore.md)

Cornelia acts as a caring friend and neighbor to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), maintaining a protective interest in her well-being despite Leslie's tragic and difficult life. Recognizing Leslie's lonely circumstances, Cornelia encourages others like [Anne](../character/anne.md) to persist in being friends with her, reassuring them of Leslie's true heart and faith.

- Friend of — caring friend and neighbor  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P29](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0029), +1 more</sub>

### [Marshall](../character/marshall.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--marshall.md)

Cornelia becomes betrothed to [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) late in her time at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). Their upcoming marriage comes as a surprise to those in the community, such as [Susan](../character/susan.md), who learns the news following a local political election.

- Romantically involved with — betrothed / going to be married  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P37](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0037)</sub>
- Spouse of — engagement/upcoming marriage  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P8](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P37](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0037)</sub>
